payload.title: The Papyrus vocabulary is published as a context generated from the relation types
payload.description:
As a machine reader, I want one published Papyrus vocabulary (a JSON-LD context mapping public relation types to SKOS and schema.org), so that links in our structured data have defined meanings. One vocabulary for all sites, published on p.apyr.us, generated from the relation-types file.

```gherkin
Feature: Published vocabulary
  Scenario: Public relation types are described once, for every site
    Given the relation-types file marks which types are public
    When the vocabulary is built
    Then it defines each public type with its label, description and direction
    And "broader than", "narrower than", "related to" and "same as" map to their SKOS terms

  Scenario: A private relation type is never in the vocabulary
    Given the relation type "quality rating is" is not marked public
    When the vocabulary is built
    Then it does not mention that type
```
